evidence: Hand-transcribed from named released source bodies; runner verifies selected values without acquisition or sampling.

observed_mock_sampling.reason: inferpymc passes draws=nit (source inspection); RhimeSampler burn slicing executed with pm.sample replaced by a synthetic trace. Tune is not part of nit. No sampling executed.

chain_summary.reason: Released convert_idata_to_dataset selects chain=0; current merge_trace_groups retains chain and stats reduces chain/draw. Arithmetic witness, not an inversion.

pollution_from_obs_with_bc_and_offset.reason: Legacy preserve_legacy_likelihood passes boundary_mean only; modern baseline includes offset. Scientific change, not a spelling rewrite.

pollution_from_obs_no_bc_with_offset.reason: Legacy baseline=None uses abs(Y)+1e-6*mean(Y); modern baseline includes offset.

no_model_error.reason: Legacy no_model_error uses max(abs(error),1e-12*nanmean(Y)) and retains unused sigma. Modern fixed_error removes sigma and ignores minimum_error; additive compatibility floor is a separate route.

additive_no_model_error.reason: Wrapper additive/no_model_error selects the compatibility minimum-error floor. Mechanical conversion to fixed_error alone changes science.

rhime_and_ordinary_wrapper.reason: params.make_rhime_runner_setup, specs.DEFAULT_* priors and _model_building fallback; RHIME fixture explicitly chooses pollution_event, wrapper chooses it itself.

direct_inferpymc_not_fixedbasisMCMC.reason: inferpymc signature and _prepare_builder_priors, not defaults for wrapper or fixedbasisMCMC

observed_errors.python_omits_mismatch_model: A standard RHIME run requires a built-in or custom likelihood.
observed_errors.true_legacy_rejects_modern_draws: --legacy-fixedbasis does not support parameter(s): draws. Use legacy fixedbasis/inferpymc option names; RHIME-only options are not translated in this mode.
